services.desc: Duration 1 Hour About You and your group decided to take a vacation, after a long, hard year. You looked online and found a remote cabin on an island, you found it weird that there were no reviews online but you decided to book it anyways. The date of your getaway comes and the owner takes you on his boat to drop you off at the cabin. Upon your arrival you begin to realize why there were no reviews...no one has ever left! The owner will be back in one hour to "check" on you. Can you get away from the cabin AND the island before he catches you? ​This creepy-themed fun experience is "spookily" fun and is designed for 4 to 8 people.
